sheets.name: Title sheet
first_rows: Practices have been mapped to their respective PCNs and Sub ICB Locations using reference data current on 01/04/2025. This mapping has been applied to data for both the current and previous reporting year; this should be borne in mind when making comparisons between years. Please be aware that the aggregated (i.e. non-practice level) figures presented for 2023-24 in this workbook will not match those published in 2023-24, as all figures have been recalculated using practice level data that can be mapped to current NHS geographies.

sheets.name: Notes and definitions
first_rows:
The following quality improvement indicator groups are represented by these initials.
Workforce and Wellbing = QIWW
Optimise use of Staff Capacilty = QIOSC
Reducing Avoidable Appointments = QIRAA
